decisions.choice: Yahweh spoke: the first of the instructions given to Moses on the mountain
decisions.reason: Moses has gone up into the cloud on the mountain and stays there forty days and forty nights (24:15-18). What God says there runs from here to 31:17, in a series of speeches that each open in much the same way (30:11, 17, 22, 34; 31:1, 12). Then God gives Moses the two tablets (31:18). The first speech, from 25:2 to 30:10, describes the tabernacle, its furnishings and the priests who serve in it.

decisions.choice: "parla", "dit" (passé simple, L and B); "a dit" (passé composé, R); the instructions that follow: future at L and B ("tu feras"), imperative at R ("Fais")
decisions.reason: The narrative frame follows the French style guide: passé simple at Literal and Balanced, passé composé at Readable. The instructions of chapters 25-31 use the future of command at Literal and Balanced and the plain imperative or "tu dois" at Readable.

ko.L: "이스라엘 자손에게 말하여, 그들이 나를 위하여 들어 바치는 제물을 가져오게 하라. 마음이 움직여 스스로 바치려는 모든 사람에게서 너희는 나에게 들어 바치는 제물을 받으라.
ko.B: "이스라엘 백성에게 말하여, 나에게 바칠 예물을 따로 떼어 놓게 하라. 마음에 감동이 되어 바치려는 사람이면 누구에게서나 너희는 나에게 바치는 예물을 받으라.
ko.R: "이스라엘 사람들에게 나를 위해 특별한 예물을 가져오라고 말해야 한다. 바치고 싶어 하는 사람이면 누구에게서나 그 예물을 받아야 한다.

vi.L: "Hãy nói với con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, để họ lấy cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một của lễ dâng riêng; từ mỗi người mà lòng họ thúc giục, các ngươi phải nhận của lễ dâng riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

vi.R: "Con hãy bảo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đem đến cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một lễ vật đặc biệt. Hãy nhận lễ vật dâng cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} từ bất cứ ai muốn dâng.

pt.B: "Fala aos israelitas, e que separem para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} uma contribuição. Vocês receberão a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} contribuição de todo aquele cujo coração o levar a dar.
pt.R: "Diz aos israelitas que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tragam uma oferta especial. Vocês devem receber a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} oferta de todos os que quiserem dá-la.

decisions.choice: contribution: something lifted off and set apart from what one has, as a gift for God
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb "to lift, raise". It is a portion taken from a person's goods and given over to God for his use. It is used of gifts for the sanctuary (35:5, 21, 24) and of portions of sacrifices given to the priests (29:27-28). The older rendering "heave offering" comes from the idea of lifting.

decisions.choice: whose heart moves him: who gives freely, of his own will
decisions.reason: The verb means to make willing or to move to give freely. The gifts are not a tax; they come from those who want to give. The same verb is used when the people bring their gifts in 35:21, 29, where "men and women" both give (35:22, 29). The word for "freewill offering" comes from the same root.

decisions.choice: they take ... you shall take: the people set the gifts apart, and Moses and his helpers receive them
decisions.reason: The people "take" the contribution from what they have, and "you" (plural, Moses and those with him) "take" it from them, that is, receive it.

decisions.choice: {{gender:everyone|every man}} whose heart moves {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: "Every man" here means each person, and 35:22, 29 show that men and women both gave. The gender setting gives the inclusive wording by default and the traditional "every man ... him" as the alternative. Readable says "everyone who wants to give", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: contribution (Balanced); special gift (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional "heave offering". Balanced says "contribution", the word used throughout the tabernacle chapters; Readable says "special gift".

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}}, {{plural_you:Recibirán|Recibiréis}}, {{plural_you:Reciban|Recibid}}
decisions.reason: The second "you shall take" is plural in Hebrew: Moses and those working with him receive the gifts (m3). Spanish marks the plural, so the verb takes the plural_you setting. Where God speaks to Moses alone the verbs stay singular ("harás").

decisions.choice: {{gender:toute personne|tout homme}} (L); "chacun de ceux que" (B), "tous ceux qui" (R), with no span
alternatives: a gender span at every level
decisions.reason: At Literal French must choose a noun, so it takes the gender setting as the English does. "Chacun de ceux que" and "tous ceux qui" already mean anyone, so Balanced and Readable need no span.

decisions.choice: God's instructions to Moses in 해라체: -하라 / -하지 말라 at Literal and Balanced, -해야 한다 / -하면 안 된다 at Readable
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch terms note sets these forms for God's commands and instructions through the laws and the tabernacle chapters (Exodus 25-31), so that chapters drafted in parallel sound alike. Korean has no deity_pronoun spans: respect for God is carried by -시- and 께서, so the English spans for "me" and "my" have nothing to match.

decisions.choice: "들어 바치는 제물" (Literal), "예물" (Balanced), "특별한 예물" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the terms note's word for terumah, something lifted off and set apart; here it is a freewill gift of materials for the tabernacle, not an altar offering, so Balanced and Readable say "예물", as the English says "contribution" and "special gift".

decisions.choice: God speaks to Moses with "ngươi" (L) and "con" (B, R), "các ngươi" (L) and "các con" (B, R) for Moses and those with him; the instructions use "phải" and "hãy" (L, B) and plain "hãy" / "đừng" sentences at R
alternatives: "con" at every level, as in Joshua 1
decisions.reason: The address the Genesis terms note sets for God speaking to one person, as in Exodus 3-24: "ngươi" keeps the distance of the Hebrew at Literal, "con" the closeness of God's word to his servant at Balanced and Readable. God's laws for the whole people keep "các ngươi" at every level. Recorded once for Exodus 25-30.

decisions.choice: "của lễ dâng riêng" (L, B), "lễ vật đặc biệt" (R)
decisions.reason: The term the Pentateuch terms note sets for terumah, a gift set apart from what one has (m1); Readable says "special gift", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: oferta alçada (L); contribuição (B); oferta especial (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (25:2-3; 35:5, 21, 24; 36:6), as the English levels: Literal keeps the traditional "oferta alçada", the Portuguese name built, like the Hebrew noun, on "lifting" (m1); Balanced says "contribuição", something set apart and handed over; Readable "oferta especial". "Tributo" would make it a tax, which m2 rules out.

decisions.choice: todo aquele cujo coração o mover (L); todo aquele cujo coração o levar a dar (B); todos os que quiserem (R); "vocês"; no gender setting
decisions.reason: Portuguese "todo aquele" and "todos os que" already include women and men (35:22, 29), so the gender setting the English needs for "every man ... him" has nothing to change, and the "o" that refers back to "todo aquele" is ordinary generic Portuguese. The second "you" is plural, Moses and those with him (m3), so God says "vocês" there, while he speaks to Moses alone with "tu" ("Fala"). Likewise the "filhos de Israel" take no setting, as decided for the book at 1:7.

decisions.choice: bronze: copper or an alloy of copper
decisions.reason: The word covers copper and its alloys. In the tabernacle it is used for the altar of burnt offering, the basin, and the bases and pegs of the courtyard (27:2-6, 19; 30:18).

decisions.choice: gold, silver and bronze: metals in order of worth
decisions.reason: The list moves from the most precious metal to the least. In the tabernacle the most precious materials are used closest to the most holy place: gold for the ark, the table and the lampstand inside, bronze for the altar in the courtyard outside. Much of this metal came from what the Egyptians gave Israel (3:22; 12:35-36).

decisions.choice: "놋" for bronze
decisions.reason: The established Bible word for copper and its alloys, used for every bronze object in Exodus 25-40; "청동" is the modern technical word.

decisions.choice: bronze
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "bronze" is the metal of the altar, the basin and the courtyard (m1), as the English says; "cobre" names only the pure metal, while the word covers copper and its alloys.

decisions.choice: blue, purple and scarlet: wool dyed in costly colors
decisions.reason: The first two colors were made from shellfish dye, the first a violet-blue and the second a red-purple; both were costly and were worn by the rich and by kings. "Scarlet" is literally "worm of scarlet": a deep red dye made from an insect. The words name the colored yarn or cloth, most likely wool, used for the curtains and the priests' garments (26:1, 31; 28:5-6).

decisions.choice: fine linen: cloth woven from flax of high quality
decisions.reason: This is the fine white linen Joseph was dressed in when Pharaoh honored him (Genesis 41:42). Linen made of flax was a well-known product of Egypt.

decisions.choice: goats: goats' hair
decisions.reason: The word is simply "goats"; the material meant is their hair, spun into yarn by the women (35:26) and woven into the curtains of the tent over the tabernacle (26:7).

decisions.choice: yarn ... goats' hair
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names only the colors and "goats". Balanced and Readable add "yarn" and "hair", which the context requires; Literal brackets them. Readable starts a new sentence, "They may also give", to break up the long list.

decisions.choice: "samawati", "zambarau", "rangi nyekundu"
decisions.reason: "Samawati" is the standard word for the blue of the first dye; "bluu" is colloquial and "urujuani" (violet) is less known. "Zambarau" is purple. These three color words are used for the yarn through the tabernacle chapters.

decisions.choice: "xanh dương, tía, đỏ thẫm" and "vải gai mịn"
decisions.reason: The colours and the fine linen as 2 Chronicles 3:14 already says them in this translation, so the tabernacle and the temple use the same words.

decisions.choice: fio azul, roxo e vermelho; linho fino
decisions.reason: For the whole book. The three colors are wool dyed blue-violet, red-purple and deep red (m1); Portuguese names them with plain color words, "azul, roxo e vermelho", so that the long lists of the tabernacle chapters read easily. "Púrpura" and "escarlate" are the older words, but in Brazil "púrpura" is more a word of poetry than a color, and the English says "purple" and "scarlet". "Linho fino" is the fine linen of m2. Literal brackets "fio", as the English Literal brackets "yarn".

decisions.choice: skins of a kind not certainly known: a fine leather
decisions.reason: The word that describes these skins is not certainly known. It names either an animal or a kind of leather. The skins formed the outermost covering of the tabernacle (26:14) and were used to wrap its holy things on the march (Numbers 4:6-14); in Ezekiel 16:10 sandals are made of them. Some connect the word with an animal of the Red Sea such as the dugong (sea cow) or the dolphin; older versions such as the King James Version said "badgers' skins"; others take it as a word for a fine, specially treated leather or for a color. What is clear is that it was a durable, valuable leather.

decisions.choice: rams' skins dyed red: tanned rams' leather colored red
decisions.reason: The skins of rams, tanned and dyed red, made the covering that lay over the goats' hair tent (26:14).

decisions.choice: acacia wood: the hard wood of the acacia tree
decisions.reason: The acacia grows in the dry country of Sinai and the Jordan valley. Its wood is hard and resists decay, and it is the wood used for the ark, the table, the altars and the frames of the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: fine leather
decisions.reason: The animal or material is uncertain (m1), so every level says "fine leather" and does not choose between the suggested animals; a footnote gives the alternatives. Readable keeps the list in its own sentence.

decisions.choice: "mbao za mshita" (acacia wood)
decisions.reason: "Mshita" is the name long used in Swahili for the acacia of the tabernacle; "mgunga" is the everyday name of acacia trees and a reviewer may prefer it. The same words are used for the ark, the table, the altars and the frames.

decisions.choice: "gỗ keo"
decisions.reason: "keo" is the Vietnamese name of the acacia tree (m3); the older transliteration "si-tim" names nothing a reader knows. Used for the whole tabernacle account.

decisions.choice: "아카시아 나무"
decisions.reason: The plain name of the tree; "조각목" is the older Bible word and is not understood today. Used for every acacia-wood object in these chapters.

decisions.choice: couro fino; madeira de acácia
decisions.reason: For the whole book. The kind of skin is not known (m1), so Portuguese says "couro fino" at every level, as the English says "fine leather", without choosing an animal; the older "peles de texugo" names a guess. "Madeira de acácia" is the hard desert wood of m3, the same at every level wherever it occurs.

decisions.choice: onyx: a precious stone, not certainly identified
decisions.reason: The stone is named with gold in the land of Havilah (Genesis 2:12). Two of them, engraved with the names of the tribes, are set on the shoulders of the ephod (28:9-12). It is probably onyx, but some take it to be carnelian or another stone.

decisions.choice: stones of setting: gems to be mounted in settings
decisions.reason: The phrase means stones for filling settings, that is, gems mounted in gold. The twelve stones of the breastpiece are set this way (28:17-20).

decisions.choice: the ephod and the breastpiece: garments of the high priest
decisions.reason: Both are described in chapter 28: the ephod, an apron-like vestment (28:6-14), and the breastpiece worn over it (28:15-30).

decisions.choice: sanctuary: a holy place, set apart for God
decisions.reason: The word comes from the root for "holy". It names the whole tabernacle as the place that belongs to God.

decisions.choice: I will dwell among them: God's purpose is to live with his people
decisions.reason: The verb means to settle or dwell, and the word for "tabernacle" in the next verse comes from it: the tabernacle is the place of God's dwelling. The aim of the whole building is stated here and again in 29:45-46: God will live among the Israelites and be their God. Leviticus 26:11-12 and Ezekiel 37:27 return to the same promise.

decisions.choice: and I will dwell: the purpose of the making
decisions.reason: The two clauses are joined by "and". The second gives the reason for the first: they are to make the sanctuary so that God may dwell among them.

decisions.choice: holy place ... live
decisions.reason: Readable says "holy place" for "sanctuary" and "live" for "dwell". "The people" names who is to make it.

decisions.choice: "nơi thánh", lowercase
decisions.reason: The whole sanctuary is meant (m1); the capitalised "Nơi Thánh" of the term sheet is kept for the outer room of the tabernacle (26:33).

decisions.choice: "머물다" (Literal, Balanced), "살다" (Readable) for dwell
decisions.reason: "거하다" is the older Bible word; "머물다" keeps the sense of God taking up residence among them, and Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: pattern: a model or plan of the thing to be built
decisions.reason: The word means a form or design, sometimes a model of something. David gives Solomon the "pattern" of the temple (1 Chronicles 28:11-19). Here it is something God shows Moses, either a model or a vision; the text does not say which. Hebrews 8:5 quotes verse 40 and calls the earthly tabernacle a copy and shadow of the heavenly one.

decisions.choice: tabernacle: the dwelling place, God's tent
decisions.reason: The word means "dwelling place" and comes from the verb "dwell" in verse 8. It names the tent God will live in among his people, and sometimes the inner tent of curtains within it (26:1).

decisions.choice: I am showing you: what God is about to show, or is showing, Moses
decisions.reason: The verb is a participle, which can describe something happening now or about to happen. Verse 40 uses the same form: "which you are being shown on the mountain".

decisions.choice: the tabernacle, the sacred tent
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "tabernacle" and adds "the sacred tent" to explain it. It says "plan" for "pattern" and turns the verse into two short sentences.

decisions.choice: furnishings
decisions.reason: The "articles" of the tabernacle are its furniture and utensils; Balanced says "furnishings". Literal keeps "articles".

decisions.choice: "la Demeure" (L, B); "le tabernacle, la tente sacrée" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means "dwelling place" and comes from the verb "dwell" in verse 8 (m2). "La Demeure", with a capital as a name, keeps that link at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the familiar "tabernacle" and explains it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "vous ferez", "Faites" (plural)
decisions.reason: "You will make" is plural here, as in verse 19: the command is for Moses and those who will do the work, while "I show you" is said to Moses alone. French keeps the change from "tu" to "vous".

decisions.choice: "성막" for the tabernacle; "본" (Literal, Balanced) and "설계도" (Readable) for pattern
decisions.reason: The terms note settles "성막" (mishkan) for the whole of Exodus to Numbers; Readable explains it once as "거룩한 장막", as the English Readable adds "the sacred tent".

decisions.choice: "Đền Tạm" for mishkan
decisions.reason: The term the Pentateuch terms note sets, already used in Joshua and Chronicles; Readable adds "cái lều thánh" as the English Readable adds "the sacred tent".

decisions.choice: o tabernáculo; o modelo (L, B); um projeto (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md): "tabernáculo" is the name Portuguese readers know for God's dwelling (m2); Readable adds "a tenda sagrada", as the English Readable does. The last verb is plural in the Hebrew ("you" all shall make it), so Literal and Balanced say "farão", "Vocês o farão", while God's "I show you" is to Moses alone, "te". "Modelo" covers both a model and a design (m1).

source.text: וְעָשׂ֥וּ אֲר֖וֹן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֨צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will make an ark of woods of acacia, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.

en.L: And they shall make an ark of acacia wood; 2 1/2 cubits [shall be] its length, and 1 1/2 cubits its breadth, and 1 1/2 cubits its height.
en.B: They are to make an ark of acacia wood, {{units:about 3 3/4 feet|2 1/2 cubits}} long, {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|1 1/2 cubits}} wide and {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|1 1/2 cubits}} high.
en.R: Have them make an ark out of acacia wood. It is the ark that will hold the covenant tablets. It must be {{units:about 3 3/4 feet|2 1/2 cubits}} long, {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|1 1/2 cubits}} wide, and {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|1 1/2 cubits}} high.

es.L: Y harán un arca de madera de acacia; dos codos y medio [será] su longitud, y un codo y medio su anchura, y un codo y medio su altura.
es.B: Harán un arca de madera de acacia de {{units:unos 1,10 metros|dos codos y medio}} de largo, {{units:unos 70 centímetros|un codo y medio}} de ancho y {{units:unos 70 centímetros|un codo y medio}} de alto.
es.R: Que hagan un arca de madera de acacia. Es el arca donde se guardarán las tablas del pacto. Debe medir {{units:unos 1,10 metros|dos codos y medio}} de largo, {{units:unos 70 centímetros|un codo y medio}} de ancho y {{units:unos 70 centímetros|un codo y medio}} de alto.

fr.L: Et ils feront une arche de bois d’acacia ; deux coudées et demie [sera] sa longueur, et une coudée et demie sa largeur, et une coudée et demie sa hauteur.
fr.B: Ils feront une arche en bois d’acacia de {{units:environ 1,10 mètre|deux coudées et demie}} de long, {{units:environ 70 centimètres|une coudée et demie}} de large et {{units:environ 70 centimètres|une coudée et demie}} de haut.
fr.R: Demande-leur de faire une arche en bois d’acacia. C’est l’arche qui contiendra les tables de l’alliance. Elle doit mesurer {{units:environ 1,10 mètre|deux coudées et demie}} de long, {{units:environ 70 centimètres|une coudée et demie}} de large et {{units:environ 70 centimètres|une coudée et demie}} de haut.

sw.L: Nao watafanya sanduku la mbao za mshita; dhiraa mbili na nusu [ndio] urefu wake, na dhiraa moja na nusu upana wake, na dhiraa moja na nusu kimo chake.
sw.B: Watengeneze sanduku la mbao za mshita, lenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 1.1|dhiraa mbili na nusu}}, upana wa {{units:karibu sentimita 70|dhiraa moja na nusu}} na kimo cha {{units:karibu sentimita 70|dhiraa moja na nusu}}.
sw.R: Waambie watengeneze sanduku kwa mbao za mshita. Ni sanduku litakalohifadhi vibao vya agano. Urefu wake uwe {{units:karibu mita 1.1|dhiraa mbili na nusu}}, upana {{units:karibu sentimita 70|dhiraa moja na nusu}}, na kimo {{units:karibu sentimita 70|dhiraa moja na nusu}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 아카시아 나무로 궤를 만들게 하라. 그 길이는 두 규빗 반, 그 너비는 한 규빗 반, 그 높이는 한 규빗 반이다.
ko.B: 그들에게 아카시아 나무로 궤를 만들게 하라. 길이는 {{units:1.1미터쯤|두 규빗 반}}, 너비는 {{units:68센티미터쯤|한 규빗 반}}, 높이는 {{units:68센티미터쯤|한 규빗 반}}으로 하라.
ko.R: 사람들에게 아카시아 나무로 궤를 만들게 해야 한다. 그 궤에는 언약의 돌판을 넣어 둘 것이다. 궤의 길이는 {{units:1.1미터쯤|두 규빗 반}}, 너비는 {{units:68센티미터쯤|한 규빗 반}}, 높이는 {{units:68센티미터쯤|한 규빗 반}}이어야 한다.

vi.L: Và họ phải làm một cái hòm bằng gỗ keo; chiều dài [của nó] hai cu-đê rưỡi, chiều rộng một cu-đê rưỡi, và chiều cao một cu-đê rưỡi.
vi.B: Họ phải làm một cái hòm bằng gỗ keo, dài {{units:khoảng 1,1 m|hai cu-đê rưỡi}}, rộng {{units:khoảng 70 cm|một cu-đê rưỡi}} và cao {{units:khoảng 70 cm|một cu-đê rưỡi}}.
vi.R: Hãy bảo họ làm một cái hòm bằng gỗ keo. Đó là cái hòm sẽ đựng hai bảng đá giao ước. Hòm phải dài {{units:khoảng 1,1 m|hai cu-đê rưỡi}}, rộng {{units:khoảng 70 cm|một cu-đê rưỡi}} và cao {{units:khoảng 70 cm|một cu-đê rưỡi}}.

pt.L: E farão uma arca de madeira de acácia; dois côvados e meio [será] o seu comprimento, e um côvado e meio a sua largura, e um côvado e meio a sua altura.
pt.B: Eles farão uma arca de madeira de acácia com {{units:cerca de 1,10 metro|dois côvados e meio}} de comprimento, {{units:cerca de 70 centímetros|um côvado e meio}} de largura e {{units:cerca de 70 centímetros|um côvado e meio}} de altura.
pt.R: Manda que eles façam uma arca de madeira de acácia. É a arca que vai guardar as tábuas da aliança. Ela deve ter {{units:cerca de 1,10 metro|dois côvados e meio}} de comprimento, {{units:cerca de 70 centímetros|um côvado e meio}} de largura e {{units:cerca de 70 centímetros|um côvado e meio}} de altura.

decisions.choice: ark: a chest or box
decisions.reason: The word means a chest. It is used of Joseph's coffin (Genesis 50:26) and of the money chest in the temple (2 Kings 12:10). It is not the word used for Noah's ark. This chest will hold the tablets of the covenant (verse 16) and is often called "the ark of the testimony" (verse 22) or "the ark of the covenant" (Numbers 10:33).

decisions.choice: cubit: the length from elbow to fingertip, about 18 inches (45 centimeters)
decisions.reason: The cubit was the common measure of length, the length of a man's forearm. The ark is 2 1/2 cubits long and 1 1/2 cubits wide and high: about 45 by 27 by 27 inches (about 113 by 68 by 68 centimeters). A longer royal cubit of about 21 inches was also used in the ancient Near East, so the figures are approximate.

decisions.choice: {{units:about 3 3/4 feet|2 1/2 cubits}} ... {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|1 1/2 cubits}}
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the measures in feet by default, rounded, with "about", and the units setting shows the original "cubits". Literal always keeps the original unit. Numerals are used in measurements.

decisions.choice: the ark that will hold the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "ark" and adds a sentence saying what it is for, since "ark" now usually means a large boat: it will hold the tablets of the covenant (verse 16). Later verses say "the ark".

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 1,10 metros|dos codos y medio}}, {{units:unos 70 centímetros|un codo y medio}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default, at 45 cm to the cubit, rounded with "unos" as the English rounds its feet; the units setting gives the original cubits, which Literal keeps. The same values are used throughout the tabernacle chapters.

decisions.choice: {{units:environ 1,10 mètre|deux coudées et demie}}, {{units:environ 70 centimètres|une coudée et demie}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default, at 45 cm to the cubit, rounded with "environ"; the units setting gives the original cubits, which Literal keeps. The same values are used throughout the tabernacle chapters.

decisions.choice: {{units:karibu mita 1.1|dhiraa mbili na nusu}}, {{units:karibu sentimita 70|dhiraa moja na nusu}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default, at 45 cm to the cubit, rounded with "karibu"; the units setting gives the original "dhiraa", which Literal keeps. The same values are used throughout the tabernacle chapters.

decisions.choice: metres by default, cubits ("cu-đê") with the Measures setting
decisions.reason: Vietnamese measures in metres, so the default converts the cubit at 45 cm, rounded as the English rounds, with a decimal comma (Genesis terms note); Literal keeps the cubit. The same values serve the whole tabernacle account.

decisions.choice: "hòm"
decisions.reason: The word the Pentateuch terms note sets for the ark, as in Joshua and Chronicles; Readable adds what it holds, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Metric measures by default (a cubit about 45 cm), the cubit as the alternative: {{units:1.1미터쯤|두 규빗 반}}
decisions.reason: As the style guide and the Genesis and Kings Korean: metric with 쯤 by default, the original unit (규빗) in the span; Literal keeps the cubits, as the English Literal does. Where a particle would differ between the two forms it is put inside the span.

decisions.choice: "궤" for the ark
decisions.reason: The terms note settles "궤" ("증거궤", "언약궤"); it is a chest, not Noah's "방주".

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 1,10 metro|dois côvados e meio}}, {{units:cerca de 70 centímetros|um côvado e meio}}
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Portuguese gives the measures in metric units by default, where the English gives feet and inches, with the original "côvados" as the alternative (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md; Genesis 6:15). A cubit is reckoned at 45 centimeters (m2), so 2 1/2 cubits are about 1,10 meter and 1 1/2 cubits about 70 centimeters, rounded with "cerca de" as the English rounds with "about"; decimals take a comma. Literal keeps "côvados".

decisions.choice: a arca; a arca que vai guardar as tábuas da aliança (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the chest is "a arca" at every level (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md), the word Portuguese readers know for the ark of the covenant, though the Hebrew word differs from Noah's (m1). Readable adds a sentence saying what it is for, as the English Readable does, and calls the testimony "as tábuas da aliança", as decided for the book at 16:34.

source.text: וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתוֹ֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ תְּצַפֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עָלָ֛יו זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will overlay it [with] gold pure, from inside and from outside you will overlay it, and you will make on it a molding of gold all around.

en.L: And you shall overlay it [with] pure gold; inside and outside you shall overlay it, and you shall make on it a molding of gold all around.
en.B: Overlay it with pure gold on the inside and the outside, and put a gold molding around it on every side.
en.R: Cover it with pure gold, inside and outside, and put a gold border all around it.

es.L: Y la revestirás [de] oro puro; por dentro y por fuera la revestirás, y harás sobre ella una moldura de oro alrededor.
es.B: La revestirás de oro puro por dentro y por fuera, y le pondrás una moldura de oro todo alrededor.
es.R: Cúbrela de oro puro por dentro y por fuera, y ponle un borde de oro todo alrededor.

fr.L: Et tu la plaqueras [d’]or pur ; à l’intérieur et à l’extérieur tu la plaqueras, et tu feras sur elle une moulure d’or tout autour.
fr.B: Tu la plaqueras d’or pur à l’intérieur et à l’extérieur, et tu feras tout autour une moulure d’or.
fr.R: Recouvre-la d’or pur, dedans et dehors, et mets une bordure d’or tout autour.

sw.L: Nawe utalifunika [kwa] dhahabu safi; ndani na nje utalifunika, nawe utalifanyia ukingo wa dhahabu kulizunguka pande zote.
sw.B: Ulifunike kwa dhahabu safi ndani na nje, na ulitie ukingo wa dhahabu pande zote.
sw.R: Lifunike kwa dhahabu safi, ndani na nje, na uweke ukingo wa dhahabu kulizunguka.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 그것을 순금으로 입히되, 안으로도 밖으로도 그것을 입히라. 그리고 그 위 사방에 금 테를 만들라.
ko.B: 궤의 안팎을 순금으로 입히고, 그 둘레에 금 테를 두르라.
ko.R: 궤의 안과 밖을 순금으로 씌우고, 둘레에 금 테두리를 둘러야 한다.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải bọc nó [bằng] vàng ròng; bên trong và bên ngoài ngươi phải bọc nó, và ngươi phải làm trên nó một đường viền bằng vàng chung quanh.
vi.B: Con phải bọc hòm bằng vàng ròng cả bên trong lẫn bên ngoài, và làm một đường viền bằng vàng chạy chung quanh.
vi.R: Hãy bọc hòm bằng vàng ròng, cả bên trong lẫn bên ngoài, và làm một đường viền bằng vàng chung quanh hòm.

pt.L: E a cobrirás [de] ouro puro; por dentro e por fora a cobrirás, e farás sobre ela uma moldura de ouro ao redor.
pt.B: Tu a revestirás de ouro puro, por dentro e por fora, e farás uma moldura de ouro ao redor dela.
pt.R: Cobre a arca de ouro puro, por dentro e por fora, e põe uma borda de ouro em toda a volta dela.

decisions.choice: overlay: cover with a thin layer of metal
decisions.reason: The wood is plated with gold. The same verb is used of the table (verse 24), the frames (26:29) and the altars (27:2; 30:3).

decisions.choice: molding: a raised border or rim
decisions.reason: The word means a border, perhaps a crown-like rim, running around the chest. It is used only of the ark, the table and the incense altar (verse 24; 30:3). Where on the ark it ran, whether around the top edge or the middle, the text does not say.

decisions.choice: pure gold: refined gold
decisions.reason: "Pure" marks gold that has been refined, used for the things nearest God's presence: the ark, the mercy seat, the table and the lampstand.

decisions.choice: "plaquer d'or", "une moulure" (L, B); "recouvrir d'or", "une bordure" (R)
decisions.reason: "Plaquer" is the craft word for covering wood with a thin layer of metal (m1); Readable says simply "recouvrir". The raised rim is "une moulure", a plain "bordure" at Readable, as the English has "molding" and "border".

decisions.choice: cobrirás (L); revestirás (B); cobre (R); uma moldura (L, B); uma borda (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book. "Revestir de ouro" is the Portuguese for plating wood with a thin layer of metal (m1); Literal says "cobrir", closer to the plain Hebrew verb, and Readable says "cobre" as the English Readable says "cover". The raised rim (m2) is "moldura" (L, B) and "borda" (R), following the English "molding" and "border". God's instructions to Moses are in the future with "tu" at Literal and Balanced and in the imperative at Readable, as the terms doc sets for the Law.

source.text: וְיָצַ֣קְתָּ לּ֗וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל־צַלְעוֹ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־צַלְע֖וֹ הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will cast for it four rings of gold, and you will put [them] on its four feet, and two rings on its one side, and two rings on its second side.

en.L: And you shall cast for it four rings of gold and put [them] on its four feet, and two rings on its one side and two rings on its second side.
en.B: Cast four rings of gold for it and fix them at its four feet, so that each side has two rings.
en.R: Cast four gold rings and attach them near its four feet, two rings on each side.

es.L: Y fundirás para ella cuatro anillos de oro, y [los] pondrás en sus cuatro patas, y dos anillos en uno de sus costados, y dos anillos en su segundo costado.
es.B: Fundirás para ella cuatro anillos de oro y los fijarás en sus cuatro patas, de modo que cada costado tenga dos anillos.
es.R: Funde cuatro anillos de oro y sujétalos cerca de sus cuatro patas, dos anillos a cada lado.

fr.L: Et tu fondras pour elle quatre anneaux d’or, et tu [les] mettras à ses quatre pieds, et deux anneaux sur l’un de ses côtés, et deux anneaux sur son second côté.
fr.B: Tu fondras pour elle quatre anneaux d’or que tu fixeras à ses quatre pieds, de sorte que chaque côté ait deux anneaux.
fr.R: Fonds quatre anneaux d’or et fixe-les près de ses quatre pieds, deux anneaux de chaque côté.

sw.L: Nawe utalisubia pete nne za dhahabu, nawe utaziweka kwenye miguu yake minne, na pete mbili upande wake mmoja, na pete mbili upande wake wa pili.
sw.B: Ulisubie pete nne za dhahabu na uzifunge kwenye miguu yake minne, ili kila upande uwe na pete mbili.
sw.R: Subu pete nne za dhahabu, uzifunge karibu na miguu yake minne, pete mbili kila upande.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 그것을 위하여 금 고리 넷을 부어 만들어 그 네 발에 달라. 곧 그 한쪽 옆에 고리 둘, 그 다른 쪽 옆에 고리 둘이다.
ko.B: 금 고리 네 개를 부어 만들어 궤의 네 발에 달되, 양쪽 옆에 두 개씩 달라.
ko.R: 금 고리 네 개를 부어 만들어서 궤의 네 발 가까이에 달아야 한다. 양쪽에 고리가 두 개씩 있어야 한다.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải đúc cho nó bốn khoen vàng và gắn [chúng] vào bốn chân nó, hai khoen ở một bên nó và hai khoen ở bên thứ hai.
vi.B: Hãy đúc bốn khoen vàng cho hòm và gắn vào bốn chân hòm, mỗi bên hai khoen.
vi.R: Hãy đúc bốn khoen vàng và gắn gần bốn chân hòm, mỗi bên hai khoen.

pt.L: E fundirás para ela quatro argolas de ouro e [as] porás nos seus quatro pés, e duas argolas num lado dela e duas argolas no seu outro lado.
pt.B: Fundirás quatro argolas de ouro para ela e as prenderás nos seus quatro pés, de modo que cada lado tenha duas argolas.
pt.R: Funde quatro argolas de ouro e prende-as perto dos quatro pés da arca, duas argolas de cada lado.

decisions.choice: cast: pour molten metal into a mold
decisions.reason: The rings are made by pouring melted gold into molds.

decisions.choice: feet: the lower corners of the chest
decisions.reason: The word usually means a foot or a step. Here it most likely means the four lower corners on which the chest stands, or small feet at those corners. The rings are placed low, so that the chest rides high when it is carried.

decisions.choice: fundir; argolas
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "argola" is the Portuguese word for a metal ring that something passes through; "anel" suggests a ring for the finger. "Fundir" is to cast metal in a mold (m1).

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בַדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make poles of woods of acacia and you will overlay them [with] gold.

en.L: And you shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them [with] gold.
en.B: You are also to make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
en.R: Make poles out of acacia wood, and cover them with gold.

es.L: Y harás barras de madera de acacia y las revestirás [de] oro.
es.B: Harás también barras de madera de acacia y las revestirás de oro.
es.R: Haz barras de madera de acacia y cúbrelas de oro.

fr.L: Et tu feras des barres de bois d’acacia, et tu les plaqueras [d’]or.
fr.B: Tu feras aussi des barres en bois d’acacia, que tu plaqueras d’or.
fr.R: Fais des barres en bois d’acacia et recouvre-les d’or.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya mipiko ya mbao za mshita, na kuifunika [kwa] dhahabu.
sw.B: Ufanye pia mipiko ya mbao za mshita, uifunike kwa dhahabu.
sw.R: Tengeneza mipiko kwa mbao za mshita, uifunike kwa dhahabu.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 아카시아 나무로 채들을 만들고, 그것들을 금으로 입히라.
ko.B: 또 아카시아 나무로 채를 만들어 금으로 입히라.
ko.R: 아카시아 나무로 궤를 멜 채를 만들고, 금으로 씌워야 한다.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải làm các đòn bằng gỗ keo và bọc chúng [bằng] vàng.
vi.B: Con cũng phải làm các đòn khiêng bằng gỗ keo và bọc vàng.
vi.R: Hãy làm các đòn khiêng bằng gỗ keo và bọc vàng.

decisions.reason: "Mpiko" is the pole on which loads are carried on the shoulder, which is what these are (m1); "miti" would also mean trees or plain sticks.

decisions.reason: "채" is the word for the poles of a carried chest or litter; Readable says what they are for. Shared craft vocabulary for Exodus 25-40, so that the instructions and the building account read as one text.

decisions.choice: varas
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the carrying poles (m1) are "varas", the plain word for long poles; "varais", the older word, now usually means a clothesline in Brazil.

decisions.choice: the testimony: the stone tablets of the covenant
decisions.reason: The "testimony" is the two stone tablets with the Ten Words written on them, which bear witness to the covenant God made with Israel. They are called "the two tablets of the testimony" (31:18; 32:15), and the ark that holds them is "the ark of the testimony" (verse 22). God promised Moses these tablets in 24:12; Moses puts them in the ark in 40:20.

decisions.choice: mercy seat: the gold lid of the ark, the place where atonement is made
decisions.reason: The word comes from the root used for "make atonement" (30:10, 15-16), and it names the solid gold lid laid on the ark (verse 21). It is more than a cover. Once a year, on the Day of Atonement, the high priest sprinkled blood on it and before it to make atonement for himself and the people (Leviticus 16:2, 13-16), and the room that held the ark could be called "the house of the mercy seat" (1 Chronicles 28:11). God speaks from above it (verse 22; Numbers 7:89). The ancient Greek translation calls it the place of atonement, and the New Testament uses that word in Romans 3:25 and Hebrews 9:5. The lid is also where God is present, enthroned above the cherubim (1 Samuel 4:4; Psalm 99:1); it is not a seat to sit on.

decisions.choice: mercy seat
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the traditional name "mercy seat", which goes back to William Tyndale's translation of 1530 and which readers know and which points to what the lid is for. A footnote gives "atonement cover" and "place of atonement" (m1).

decisions.choice: the lid of the ark ... the place where sins are covered
decisions.reason: Readable says what the mercy seat is, the lid of the ark, and adds a sentence on its purpose: it is where atonement is made, where sins are covered (Leviticus 16:14-16). Later verses call it "the lid".

decisions.choice: "el propiciatorio" (L, B); "la tapa del arca" (R)
decisions.reason: "Propiciatorio" is the established Spanish name for the lid as the place of atonement, from the same idea as the Greek word in Romans 3:25 (m1). Readable says what it is, "la tapa", as the English Readable says "the lid".

decisions.choice: "le propitiatoire" (L, B); "le couvercle de l'arche" (R)
decisions.reason: "Propitiatoire" is the traditional French name of the lid as the place of atonement, matching the Greek word used in Romans 3:25 and Hebrews 9:5 (m1). Readable says what it is, "le couvercle", as the English Readable says "the lid".

decisions.choice: "kiti cha rehema" (L, B); "kifuniko cha sanduku" (R)
decisions.reason: "Kiti cha rehema" (mercy seat) is the familiar Swahili name and matches the English. Readable says "kifuniko" (lid), as the English Readable does, and explains its purpose.

decisions.choice: "nắp thi ân" (L, B), "nắp hòm ... nơi tội lỗi được che phủ" (R)
decisions.reason: The term the Pentateuch terms note sets for kapporet; Readable says what it is, as the English Readable does (m1).

decisions.choice: "속죄소" (Literal, Balanced); Readable "궤의 뚜껑", explained once as "속죄소, 곧 죄를 덮어 주는 곳"
decisions.reason: The terms note settles "속죄소" for kapporet. The English Readable calls it the lid of the ark, the place where sins are covered; Korean Readable says "뚜껑" from here on and gives the familiar name once.

decisions.choice: o propiciatório (L, B); a tampa da arca ... o lugar onde os pecados são cobertos (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md): "propiciatório" is the name of the gold lid in the Portuguese Bible tradition, and it names, as m1 asks, the place where atonement is made, not just a cover; it is also the word of Hebrews 9:5 in Portuguese. Readable says "a tampa da arca" and adds a sentence on its purpose, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: cherubim: winged heavenly beings who guard God's holy presence
decisions.reason: Cherubim guard the way to the tree of life (Genesis 3:24), and God is spoken of as enthroned above the cherubim (1 Samuel 4:4; 2 Samuel 6:2; Psalm 99:1). Ezekiel describes them with wings and faces (Ezekiel 10). Here two gold figures of them stand on the mercy seat, and figures of them are woven into the curtains (26:1, 31). The text does not describe their form beyond their wings and faces (verse 20).

decisions.choice: hammered work: beaten from a single piece of metal
decisions.reason: The cherubim are not cast and attached; they are beaten out of the same piece of gold as the mercy seat (verse 19). The lampstand is made the same way (verses 31, 36).

decisions.choice: Cherubim are winged heavenly creatures.
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "cherubim" and adds a sentence to say what they are; their wings are described in verse 20.

decisions.choice: "kazi ya kufua" (L); "dhahabu iliyofuliwa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Kufua" is the smith's verb for beating metal into shape, which is what "hammered work" means (m2). The same words are used for the lampstand (verses 31, 36).

decisions.choice: "chê-ru-bim"; "đồ gò" / "gò" for hammered work
decisions.reason: The transliteration the Pentateuch terms note sets, as in Chronicles; "gò" is the smith's word for beating metal into shape from one piece (m2).

decisions.choice: "그룹", "그룹들" for cherub, cherubim
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps the Korean Bible form "그룹". Because it sounds like the everyday word for a group, Readable says what a cherub is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: querubins; obra batida (L); ouro batido (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "querubim" is the singular and "querubins" the plural in Portuguese (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md). The work is gold beaten out of one piece (m2): Literal keeps "obra batida", and Balanced and Readable say "ouro batido", the goldsmith's phrase.

source.text: וַ֠עֲשֵׂה כְּר֨וּב אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב־אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֶת־הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And make one cherub from [the] end on this [side], and one cherub from [the] end on that [side]; from the mercy seat you will make the cherubim on its two ends.

en.L: And make one cherub at the end on this [side] and one cherub at the end on that [side]; of the mercy seat you shall make the cherubim, on its two ends.
en.B: Form one cherub at this end and another at that end. The cherubim are to be shaped out of the mercy seat itself, at its two ends.
en.R: Place a cherub at each end of the lid. Make the cherubim and the lid all from one piece of gold.

es.L: Y haz un querubín en el extremo de este [lado] y un querubín en el extremo de aquel [lado]; del propiciatorio {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} los querubines, en sus dos extremos.
es.B: Forma un querubín en un extremo y otro en el otro extremo. Los querubines se formarán del mismo propiciatorio, en sus dos extremos.
es.R: Pon un querubín en cada extremo de la tapa. Haz los querubines y la tapa de una sola pieza de oro.

fr.L: Et fais un chérubin à l’extrémité de ce [côté]-ci et un chérubin à l’extrémité de ce [côté]-là ; du propitiatoire vous ferez les chérubins, à ses deux extrémités.
fr.B: Tu façonneras un chérubin à une extrémité et un autre à l’autre extrémité. Les chérubins seront formés du propitiatoire lui-même, à ses deux extrémités.
fr.R: Place un chérubin à chaque bout du couvercle. Fais les chérubins et le couvercle d’une seule pièce d’or.

sw.L: Nawe fanya kerubi mmoja kwenye ncha hii, na kerubi mmoja kwenye ncha ile; kutoka kiti cha rehema mtawafanya makerubi, kwenye ncha zake mbili.
sw.B: Ufanye kerubi mmoja kwenye ncha moja na mwingine kwenye ncha nyingine. Makerubi hao wafanywe kutoka kiti cha rehema chenyewe, kwenye ncha zake mbili.
sw.R: Weka kerubi mmoja kila ncha ya kifuniko. Tengeneza makerubi na kifuniko kutoka kipande kimoja cha dhahabu.

ko.L: 그리고 한 그룹은 이쪽 끝에서, 한 그룹은 저쪽 끝에서 만들라. 속죄소로부터 그룹들을 그 두 끝에 만들라.
ko.B: 한 그룹은 이쪽 끝에, 다른 한 그룹은 저쪽 끝에 만들라. 그룹들을 속죄소와 한 덩이가 되게 그 양쪽 끝에 만들라.
ko.R: 뚜껑의 양쪽 끝에 그룹을 하나씩 두어야 한다. 그룹들과 뚜껑은 모두 금 한 덩이로 만들어야 한다.

vi.L: Và hãy làm một chê-ru-bim ở đầu bên này và một chê-ru-bim ở đầu bên kia; các ngươi phải làm các chê-ru-bim liền với nắp thi ân, ở hai đầu nó.
vi.B: Hãy làm một chê-ru-bim ở đầu này và một chê-ru-bim ở đầu kia. Các chê-ru-bim phải được làm liền một khối với nắp thi ân, ở hai đầu nắp.
vi.R: Hãy đặt ở mỗi đầu nắp hòm một chê-ru-bim. Hãy làm các chê-ru-bim và nắp hòm từ cùng một khối vàng.

pt.L: E faz um querubim na extremidade deste [lado] e um querubim na extremidade daquele [lado]; do propiciatório farão os querubins, nas suas duas extremidades.
pt.B: Farás um querubim numa extremidade e o outro na outra extremidade. Os querubins serão formados do próprio propiciatório, nas suas duas extremidades.
pt.R: Põe um querubim em cada ponta da tampa. Faz os querubins e a tampa de uma só peça de ouro.

decisions.choice: from the mercy seat: of one piece with it
decisions.reason: "From the mercy seat" means that the cherubim are made out of the same piece of gold as the mercy seat, as "hammered work" in verse 18 implies.

source.text: וְהָי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֑יו אֶל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת יִהְי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be the cherubim spreading out wings upward, covering with their wings over the mercy seat, and their faces each to his brother; toward the mercy seat will be [the] faces of the cherubim.

en.L: And the cherubim shall be spreading out [their] wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces each toward his brother; toward the mercy seat shall be the faces of the cherubim.
en.B: The cherubim are to spread their wings out above, sheltering the mercy seat with their wings. They are to face one another, with their faces turned toward the mercy seat.
en.R: The cherubim must spread their wings upward over the lid, sheltering it. They must face each other and turn their faces toward the lid.

es.L: Y los querubines estarán extendiendo [sus] alas hacia arriba, cubriendo el propiciatorio con sus alas, y sus rostros cada uno hacia su hermano; hacia el propiciatorio estarán los rostros de los querubines.
es.B: Los querubines extenderán sus alas hacia arriba, cubriendo con ellas el propiciatorio. Estarán uno frente al otro, con el rostro vuelto hacia el propiciatorio.
es.R: Los querubines deben extender sus alas hacia arriba, por encima de la tapa, para protegerla. Deben mirarse el uno al otro, con la cara vuelta hacia la tapa.

fr.L: Et les chérubins déploieront [leurs] ailes vers le haut, couvrant le propitiatoire de leurs ailes, et leurs faces chacun vers son frère ; vers le propitiatoire seront les faces des chérubins.
fr.B: Les chérubins étendront leurs ailes vers le haut et abriteront de leurs ailes le propitiatoire. Ils se feront face, le visage tourné vers le propitiatoire.
fr.R: Les chérubins doivent étendre leurs ailes vers le haut, au-dessus du couvercle, pour l’abriter. Ils doivent se regarder l’un l’autre et tourner le visage vers le couvercle.

sw.L: Na makerubi watakuwa wakiyakunjua mabawa [yao] juu, wakikifunika kiti cha rehema kwa mabawa yao, na nyuso zao kila mmoja kwa ndugu yake; kuelekea kiti cha rehema zitakuwa nyuso za makerubi.
sw.B: Makerubi wayakunjue mabawa yao juu, wakikitia kivuli kiti cha rehema kwa mabawa yao. Waelekeane, nyuso zao zikielekea kiti cha rehema.
sw.R: Makerubi lazima wakunjue mabawa yao juu ya kifuniko, wakikikinga. Lazima watazamane, nyuso zao zikielekea kifuniko.

ko.L: 그리고 그룹들은 날개를 위로 펴고, 그 날개로 속죄소를 덮고, 그들의 얼굴은 각각 자기 형제를 향하게 하라. 속죄소를 향하여 그룹들의 얼굴이 있게 하라.
ko.B: 그룹들은 날개를 위로 펴서 그 날개로 속죄소를 덮게 하고, 서로 마주 보되 얼굴은 속죄소 쪽을 향하게 하라.
ko.R: 그룹들은 날개를 위로 펴서 뚜껑을 덮어 가려야 한다. 그룹들은 서로 마주 보고, 얼굴은 뚜껑 쪽을 내려다보아야 한다.

vi.L: Và các chê-ru-bim sẽ dang cánh lên trên, lấy cánh mình che nắp thi ân, và mặt chúng hướng về nhau; mặt các chê-ru-bim sẽ hướng về nắp thi ân.
vi.B: Các chê-ru-bim phải dang cánh lên trên, lấy cánh che phủ nắp thi ân. Chúng phải đối mặt nhau, mặt hướng xuống nắp thi ân.
vi.R: Các chê-ru-bim phải dang cánh lên trên nắp hòm để che phủ nắp. Chúng phải đối mặt nhau và nhìn xuống nắp hòm.

pt.L: E os querubins estarão estendendo [as] asas para cima, cobrindo o propiciatório com as suas asas, e as suas faces cada um para o seu irmão; para o propiciatório estarão as faces dos querubins.
pt.B: Os querubins terão as asas estendidas para cima, abrigando o propiciatório com elas. Ficarão de frente um para o outro, com o rosto voltado para o propiciatório.
pt.R: Os querubins devem abrir as asas para cima, sobre a tampa, como se a protegessem. Eles devem ficar de frente um para o outro e olhar para a tampa.

decisions.choice: covering: sheltering, screening
decisions.reason: The verb means to screen or shelter, as a bird covers with its wings. The cherubim's wings overshadow the mercy seat (1 Kings 8:7; Hebrews 9:5).

decisions.choice: each toward his brother: facing one another
decisions.reason: "A man to his brother" is a Hebrew way of saying "one another", used here of the two figures.

decisions.choice: faces toward the mercy seat: looking down at the lid
decisions.reason: The two cherubim face each other and look down toward the mercy seat between them.

decisions.choice: "hướng về nhau"
decisions.reason: The idiom "each toward his brother" means facing one another (m2); said literally it would make the cherubim kin, so Literal keeps the sense.

decisions.choice: cada um para o seu irmão
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "a man to his brother" (m2) as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say "um para o outro", the Portuguese for "one another".

source.text: וְנָתַתָּ֧ אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶל־הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put the mercy seat on the ark from to above, and into the ark you will put the testimony which I will give to you.

en.L: And you shall put the mercy seat on the ark, on top, and into the ark you shall put the testimony which I will give you.
en.B: The mercy seat is to go on top of the ark, and inside the ark you are to put the testimony I will give you.
en.R: Put the lid on top of the ark, and put the covenant tablets that I will give you inside the ark.

es.L: Y pondrás el propiciatorio sobre el arca, encima, y en el arca pondrás el Testimonio que yo te daré.
es.B: El propiciatorio irá encima del arca, y dentro del arca pondrás el Testimonio que te daré.
es.R: Pon la tapa encima del arca, y pon dentro del arca las tablas del pacto que te voy a dar.

fr.L: Et tu mettras le propitiatoire sur l’arche, par-dessus, et dans l’arche tu mettras le Témoignage que je te donnerai.
fr.B: Le propitiatoire sera placé sur le dessus de l’arche, et dans l’arche tu mettras le Témoignage que je te donnerai.
fr.R: Pose le couvercle sur l’arche, et mets dans l’arche les tables de l’alliance que je vais te donner.

sw.L: Nawe utaweka kiti cha rehema juu ya sanduku, kwa juu, na ndani ya sanduku utaweka Ushuhuda nitakaokupa.
sw.B: Kiti cha rehema kiwekwe juu ya sanduku, na ndani ya sanduku uweke Ushuhuda nitakaokupa.
sw.R: Weka kifuniko juu ya sanduku, na uweke ndani ya sanduku vibao vya agano nitakavyokupa.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 속죄소를 궤 위에 얹고, 궤 안에는 내가 너에게 줄 증거를 넣으라.
ko.B: 속죄소는 궤 위에 얹고, 궤 안에는 내가 너에게 줄 증거를 넣으라.
ko.R: 뚜껑을 궤 위에 덮어야 한다. 그리고 내가 너에게 줄 언약의 돌판을 궤 안에 넣어 두어야 한다.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải đặt nắp thi ân lên trên hòm, và vào trong hòm ngươi phải đặt chứng ước mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho ngươi.
vi.B: Nắp thi ân phải đặt ở trên hòm, và trong hòm con phải để chứng ước mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho con.
vi.R: Hãy đặt nắp lên trên hòm, và đặt vào trong hòm hai bảng đá giao ước mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho con.

pt.L: E porás o propiciatório sobre a arca, por cima, e na arca porás o Testemunho que eu te darei.
pt.B: O propiciatório ficará em cima da arca, e dentro da arca colocarás o Testemunho que eu te darei.
pt.R: Põe a tampa em cima da arca e coloca dentro da arca as tábuas da aliança que eu vou te dar.

decisions.choice: into the ark ... the testimony: the command of verse 16 repeated
decisions.reason: The repetition joins the two things that belong together: the tablets of the covenant inside the ark and the mercy seat over them. When the tabernacle is set up, Moses puts the testimony in the ark and then sets the mercy seat on it (40:20).

decisions.choice: from above: on top
decisions.reason: The mercy seat lies on the top of the ark as its lid.

source.text: וְנוֹעַדְתִּ֣י לְךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְדִבַּרְתִּ֨י אִתְּךָ֜ מֵעַ֣ל הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת מִבֵּין֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת אֵ֣ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֲצַוֶּ֛ה אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I will meet you there and I will speak with you from above the mercy seat, from between [the] two cherubim which [are] on [the] ark of the testimony, all that I will command you to [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And I will meet with you there, and I will speak with you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which [are] on the ark of the testimony, all that I will command you for the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: I will meet with you there. I will speak with you from above the mercy seat, from the space between the two cherubim on the ark of the testimony, and give you every command meant for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: I will meet with you there, above the lid, between the two cherubim on the ark that holds the covenant tablets. From there I will tell you all the commands you are to give the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: Y allí {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} encontraré contigo, y hablaré contigo desde encima del propiciatorio, desde entre los dos querubines que [están] sobre el arca del Testimonio, todo lo que te mandaré para los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Allí {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} reuniré contigo. Desde encima del propiciatorio, desde el espacio entre los dos querubines que están sobre el arca del Testimonio, hablaré contigo y te daré todas las órdenes para los israelitas.
es.R: Allí {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} reuniré contigo, encima de la tapa, entre los dos querubines que están sobre el arca donde están las tablas del pacto. Desde allí te diré todos los mandamientos que debes dar a los israelitas.

fr.L: Et je te rencontrerai là, et je parlerai avec toi de dessus le propitiatoire, d’entre les deux chérubins qui [sont] sur l’arche du Témoignage, [de] tout ce que je t’ordonnerai pour les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: C’est là que je te rencontrerai. Je te parlerai de dessus le propitiatoire, de l’espace entre les deux chérubins placés sur l’arche du Témoignage, et je te donnerai tous les ordres destinés aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Je te rencontrerai là, au-dessus du couvercle, entre les deux chérubins qui sont sur l’arche où se trouvent les tables de l’alliance. De là, je te dirai tous les commandements que tu devras donner aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Nami nitakutana nawe huko, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitasema nawe kutoka juu ya kiti cha rehema, kutoka kati ya makerubi wawili walio juu ya sanduku la Ushuhuda, yote nitakayokuamuru kwa ajili ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Huko nitakutana nawe. Nitasema nawe kutoka juu ya kiti cha rehema, kutoka mahali kati ya makerubi wawili walio juu ya sanduku la Ushuhuda, na kukupa kila amri kwa ajili ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: Nitakutana nawe huko, juu ya kifuniko, kati ya makerubi wawili walio juu ya sanduku lenye vibao vya agano. Kutoka huko nitakuambia amri zote utakazowapa Waisraeli.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 거기서 너를 만나고, 속죄소 위에서, 증거궤 위에 있는 두 그룹 사이에서 너와 말하겠다. 곧 내가 이스라엘 자손에게 [주라고] 너에게 명령할 모든 것을 [말하겠다].
ko.B: 거기서 내가 너를 만나겠다. 증거궤 위에 있는 두 그룹 사이, 곧 속죄소 위에서 너와 말하며, 이스라엘 백성을 위한 모든 명령을 너에게 주겠다.
ko.R: 나는 거기, 언약의 돌판을 넣은 궤의 뚜껑 위, 두 그룹 사이에서 너를 만나겠다. 거기서 나는 네가 이스라엘 사람들에게 전해야 할 모든 명령을 너에게 말해 주겠다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ gặp ngươi tại đó, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nói với ngươi từ phía trên nắp thi ân, từ giữa hai chê-ru-bim ở trên hòm chứng ước, mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ truyền cho ngươi về con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Ta sẽ gặp con tại đó. Từ phía trên nắp thi ân, ở giữa hai chê-ru-bim trên hòm chứng ước, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nói với con và ban cho con mọi mệnh lệnh dành cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Ta sẽ gặp con tại đó, phía trên nắp hòm, giữa hai chê-ru-bim trên cái hòm đựng hai bảng đá giao ước. Từ nơi đó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho con biết mọi điều răn con phải truyền lại cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

pt.L: E ali eu me encontrarei contigo e falarei contigo de cima do propiciatório, do meio dos dois querubins que [estão] sobre a arca do Testemunho, tudo o que eu te ordenar para os filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Ali eu me encontrarei contigo. Falarei contigo de cima do propiciatório, do espaço entre os dois querubins que estão sobre a arca do Testemunho, e te darei todas as ordens destinadas aos israelitas.
pt.R: Eu vou me encontrar contigo ali, em cima da tampa, entre os dois querubins que estão sobre a arca que guarda as tábuas da aliança. Dali eu vou te dizer todos os mandamentos que deves dar aos israelitas.

decisions.choice: I will meet: meet by appointment
decisions.reason: The verb means to meet at an appointed place or time. The "tent of meeting" takes its name from the same root (27:21; 29:42-43, where God says "there I will meet with you").

decisions.choice: I will speak with you from above the mercy seat: the place where God speaks
decisions.reason: The space above the mercy seat, between the cherubim, is where God makes himself present and speaks. Numbers 7:89 tells how Moses heard the voice speaking to him from there.

decisions.choice: the ark of the testimony: the chest that holds the tablets
decisions.reason: The ark is named for what it holds, the tablets of the testimony (verse 16). The same ark is called "the ark of the covenant" elsewhere (Numbers 10:33; Deuteronomy 10:8).

decisions.choice: the ark that holds the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable says "the ark that holds the covenant tablets" for "the ark of the testimony" (verse 16). It also says "the commands you are to give", which is what "command you to the Israelites" means.

decisions.choice: "hòm chứng ước"
decisions.reason: The ark is named by what it holds (m3), with the term of the Pentateuch terms note; Readable says it outright.

decisions.choice: me encontrarei contigo; a arca do Testemunho
decisions.reason: "Encontrar-se com" is meeting at an appointed place (m1), and it shares its root with "encontro" in "a tenda do encontro", the name the book uses for the tent of meeting (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md), so the link the meaning note draws is heard in Portuguese too.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ שֻׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכּוֹ֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make a table [of] woods of acacia, two cubits its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.

en.L: And you shall make a table [of] acacia wood; 2 cubits [shall be] its length, and 1 cubit its breadth, and 1 1/2 cubits its height.
en.B: Make a table of acacia wood, {{units:about 3 feet|2 cubits}} long, {{units:about 1 1/2 feet|1 cubit}} wide and {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|1 1/2 cubits}} high.
en.R: Make a table out of acacia wood. It must be {{units:about 3 feet|2 cubits}} long, {{units:about 1 1/2 feet|1 cubit}} wide, and {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|1 1/2 cubits}} high.

es.L: Y harás una mesa [de] madera de acacia; dos codos [será] su longitud, y un codo su anchura, y un codo y medio su altura.
es.B: Harás una mesa de madera de acacia de {{units:unos 90 centímetros|dos codos}} de largo, {{units:unos 45 centímetros|un codo}} de ancho y {{units:unos 70 centímetros|un codo y medio}} de alto.
es.R: Haz una mesa de madera de acacia. Debe medir {{units:unos 90 centímetros|dos codos}} de largo, {{units:unos 45 centímetros|un codo}} de ancho y {{units:unos 70 centímetros|un codo y medio}} de alto.

fr.L: Et tu feras une table [de] bois d’acacia ; deux coudées [sera] sa longueur, et une coudée sa largeur, et une coudée et demie sa hauteur.
fr.B: Tu feras une table en bois d’acacia, de {{units:environ 90 centimètres|deux coudées}} de long, {{units:environ 45 centimètres|une coudée}} de large et {{units:environ 70 centimètres|une coudée et demie}} de haut.
fr.R: Fais une table en bois d’acacia. Elle doit mesurer {{units:environ 90 centimètres|deux coudées}} de long, {{units:environ 45 centimètres|une coudée}} de large et {{units:environ 70 centimètres|une coudée et demie}} de haut.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya meza [ya] mbao za mshita; dhiraa mbili [ndio] urefu wake, na dhiraa moja upana wake, na dhiraa moja na nusu kimo chake.
sw.B: Ufanye meza ya mbao za mshita, yenye urefu wa {{units:karibu sentimita 90|dhiraa mbili}}, upana wa {{units:karibu sentimita 45|dhiraa moja}} na kimo cha {{units:karibu sentimita 70|dhiraa moja na nusu}}.
sw.R: Tengeneza meza kwa mbao za mshita. Urefu wake uwe {{units:karibu sentimita 90|dhiraa mbili}}, upana {{units:karibu sentimita 45|dhiraa moja}}, na kimo {{units:karibu sentimita 70|dhiraa moja na nusu}}.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 아카시아 나무로 상을 만들라. 그 길이는 두 규빗, 그 너비는 한 규빗, 그 높이는 한 규빗 반이다.
ko.B: 아카시아 나무로 상을 만들되, 길이는 {{units:90센티미터쯤|두 규빗}}, 너비는 {{units:45센티미터쯤|한 규빗}}, 높이는 {{units:68센티미터쯤|한 규빗 반}}으로 하라.
ko.R: 아카시아 나무로 상을 만들어야 한다. 길이는 {{units:90센티미터쯤|두 규빗}}, 너비는 {{units:45센티미터쯤|한 규빗}}, 높이는 {{units:68센티미터쯤|한 규빗 반}}이어야 한다.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải làm một cái bàn [bằng] gỗ keo; chiều dài [của nó] hai cu-đê, chiều rộng một cu-đê, và chiều cao một cu-đê rưỡi.
vi.B: Hãy làm một cái bàn bằng gỗ keo, dài {{units:khoảng 90 cm|hai cu-đê}}, rộng {{units:khoảng 45 cm|một cu-đê}} và cao {{units:khoảng 70 cm|một cu-đê rưỡi}}.
vi.R: Hãy làm một cái bàn bằng gỗ keo. Bàn phải dài {{units:khoảng 90 cm|hai cu-đê}}, rộng {{units:khoảng 45 cm|một cu-đê}} và cao {{units:khoảng 70 cm|một cu-đê rưỡi}}.

pt.L: E farás uma mesa [de] madeira de acácia; dois côvados [será] o seu comprimento, e um côvado a sua largura, e um côvado e meio a sua altura.
pt.B: Farás uma mesa de madeira de acácia com {{units:cerca de 90 centímetros|dois côvados}} de comprimento, {{units:cerca de 45 centímetros|um côvado}} de largura e {{units:cerca de 70 centímetros|um côvado e meio}} de altura.
pt.R: Faz uma mesa de madeira de acácia. Ela deve ter {{units:cerca de 90 centímetros|dois côvados}} de comprimento, {{units:cerca de 45 centímetros|um côvado}} de largura e {{units:cerca de 70 centímetros|um côvado e meio}} de altura.

decisions.choice: a table: the table for the bread of the Presence
decisions.reason: The table holds the bread of the Presence (verse 30) and stands in the holy place, on the north side, across from the lampstand (26:35). Its size, about 36 by 18 by 27 inches (about 90 by 45 by 68 centimeters), is given in cubits (see verse 10).

decisions.choice: {{units:about 3 feet|2 cubits}} ... {{units:about 1 1/2 feet|1 cubit}} ... {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|1 1/2 cubits}}
decisions.reason: As in verse 10, the measures are given in feet with the original cubits in the units setting; Literal keeps cubits.

source.text: וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will overlay it [with] gold pure, and you will make for it a molding of gold all around.

en.L: And you shall overlay it [with] pure gold, and make for it a molding of gold all around.
en.B: Overlay it with pure gold, and give it a gold molding all the way around.
en.R: Cover it with pure gold, and put a gold border all around it.

es.L: Y la revestirás [de] oro puro, y le harás una moldura de oro alrededor.
es.B: La revestirás de oro puro y le pondrás una moldura de oro todo alrededor.
es.R: Cúbrela de oro puro y ponle un borde de oro todo alrededor.

fr.L: Et tu la plaqueras [d’]or pur, et tu lui feras une moulure d’or tout autour.
fr.B: Tu la plaqueras d’or pur et tu lui feras une moulure d’or sur tout le pourtour.
fr.R: Recouvre-la d’or pur, et mets une bordure d’or tout autour.

sw.L: Nawe utaifunika [kwa] dhahabu safi, na kuifanyia ukingo wa dhahabu pande zote.
sw.B: Uifunike kwa dhahabu safi, na uitie ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka pande zote.
sw.R: Ifunike kwa dhahabu safi, na uweke ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 그것을 순금으로 입히고, 그것을 위하여 사방에 금 테를 만들라.
ko.B: 상을 순금으로 입히고, 그 둘레에 금 테를 두르라.
ko.R: 상을 순금으로 씌우고, 둘레에 금 테두리를 둘러야 한다.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải bọc nó [bằng] vàng ròng, và làm cho nó một đường viền bằng vàng chung quanh.
vi.B: Hãy bọc bàn bằng vàng ròng và làm một đường viền bằng vàng chạy chung quanh.
vi.R: Hãy bọc bàn bằng vàng ròng và làm một đường viền bằng vàng chung quanh bàn.

pt.L: E a cobrirás [de] ouro puro, e farás para ela uma moldura de ouro ao redor.
pt.B: Tu a revestirás de ouro puro e farás uma moldura de ouro em toda a volta dela.
pt.R: Cobre a mesa de ouro puro e põe uma borda de ouro em toda a volta dela.

decisions.choice: overlay ... molding: as for the ark
decisions.reason: The table is finished the same way as the ark (verse 11): overlaid with pure gold and given a gold molding around it.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ לּ֥וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ זֵר־זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתּ֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make for it a rim [of] a handbreadth all around, and you will make a molding of gold for its rim all around.

en.L: And you shall make for it a frame of a handbreadth all around, and you shall make a molding of gold for its frame all around.
en.B: Give it a frame {{units:about 3 inches|a handbreadth}} wide on every side, with a gold molding all around the frame.
en.R: Make a frame {{units:about 3 inches|a handbreadth}} wide all around it, and put a gold border around the frame.

es.L: Y le harás un marco de un ancho de mano alrededor, y harás una moldura de oro para su marco alrededor.
es.B: Le harás un marco de {{units:unos 7,5 centímetros|un ancho de mano}} de ancho por todos los lados, con una moldura de oro alrededor del marco.
es.R: Haz alrededor de la mesa un marco de {{units:unos 7,5 centímetros|un ancho de mano}} de ancho, y pon un borde de oro alrededor del marco.

fr.L: Et tu lui feras un cadre d’une largeur de main tout autour, et tu feras une moulure d’or à son cadre tout autour.
fr.B: Tu lui feras un cadre de {{units:environ 7,5 centimètres|une largeur de main}} sur tout le pourtour, avec une moulure d’or autour du cadre.
fr.R: Fais tout autour un cadre de {{units:environ 7,5 centimètres|une largeur de main}} de large, et mets une bordure d’or autour du cadre.

sw.L: Nawe utaifanyia kiunzi cha upana wa kiganja pande zote, nawe utafanya ukingo wa dhahabu kwa ajili ya kiunzi chake pande zote.
sw.B: Uifanyie kiunzi chenye upana wa {{units:karibu sentimita 7.5|kiganja kimoja}} pande zote, na ukingo wa dhahabu kukizunguka kiunzi hicho.
sw.R: Ifanyie kiunzi cha upana wa {{units:karibu sentimita 7.5|kiganja kimoja}} kuizunguka, na uweke ukingo wa dhahabu kuzunguka kiunzi hicho.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 그것을 위하여 사방에 손바닥 너비의 턱을 만들고, 그 턱을 위하여 사방에 금 테를 만들라.
ko.B: 상 둘레에 너비가 {{units:7.5센티미터쯤|손바닥 너비}}인 턱을 만들고, 그 턱 둘레에 금 테를 두르라.
ko.R: 상 둘레에 너비가 {{units:7.5센티미터쯤|손바닥 너비}}인 턱을 만들고, 그 턱에 금 테두리를 둘러야 한다.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải làm cho nó một cái khung [rộng] một bề ngang bàn tay chung quanh, và ngươi phải làm một đường viền bằng vàng cho khung nó chung quanh.
vi.B: Hãy làm cho bàn một cái khung rộng {{units:khoảng 7,5 cm|một bề ngang bàn tay}} chung quanh, và làm một đường viền bằng vàng quanh khung.
vi.R: Hãy làm một cái khung rộng {{units:khoảng 7,5 cm|một bề ngang bàn tay}} chung quanh bàn, và làm một đường viền bằng vàng quanh khung.

pt.L: E farás para ela uma armação de um palmo ao redor, e farás uma moldura de ouro para a sua armação ao redor.
pt.B: Farás para ela uma armação de {{units:cerca de 7,5 centímetros|um palmo}} de largura em toda a volta, com uma moldura de ouro ao redor da armação.
pt.R: Faz uma armação de {{units:cerca de 7,5 centímetros|um palmo}} de largura em toda a volta da mesa e põe uma borda de ouro ao redor da armação.

decisions.choice: frame: a rim or a band joining the legs
decisions.reason: The word means something that encloses: a rim or frame. It may be a raised rim around the tabletop, or a band of wood joining the legs below the top to brace them. Verse 27 places the rings for the poles near it, beside the legs, which fits a frame between the legs.

decisions.choice: handbreadth: the width of a hand across the four fingers, about 3 inches (7.5 centimeters)
decisions.reason: The handbreadth was a sixth of a cubit and the smallest common measure of length.

decisions.choice: {{units:about 3 inches|a handbreadth}}
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the modern measure by default, and the units setting shows the original "a handbreadth". Literal keeps "handbreadth".

decisions.choice: "un ancho de mano" (handbreadth)
decisions.reason: "Palmo" in ordinary Spanish is the span of the open hand, a different and larger measure (about 23 cm); "un ancho de mano" says what the handbreadth is. B and R give 7,5 cm by default.

decisions.choice: "une largeur de main" (handbreadth)
decisions.reason: The old French unit "palme" is little known today and is easily confused with "empan" (the span); "une largeur de main" says what the measure is. B and R give 7,5 cm by default.

decisions.choice: "một bề ngang bàn tay"
decisions.reason: The handbreadth is the width of the hand across four fingers (m2); "gang tay" is the longer span of 28:16.

decisions.choice: uma armação; {{units:cerca de 7,5 centímetros|um palmo}}
decisions.reason: "Armação" is a frame and fits either reading of m1, a rim around the top or a band joining the legs; "borda" is kept for the gold border. The handbreadth (m2) is "palmo" in the Portuguese measure tradition, reckoned at 7,5 centimeters (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md); Literal keeps "palmo".

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make for it four rings of gold, and you will put the rings on the four corners which [belong] to its four feet.

en.L: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners which [belong] to its four feet.
en.B: Make it four rings of gold and set them at the four corners, one by each of its four legs.
en.R: Make four gold rings and put one at each corner, beside each of its four legs.

es.L: Y le harás cuatro anillos de oro, y pondrás los anillos en las cuatro esquinas que [corresponden] a sus cuatro patas.
es.B: Le harás cuatro anillos de oro y los colocarás en las cuatro esquinas, uno junto a cada una de sus cuatro patas.
es.R: Haz cuatro anillos de oro y pon uno en cada esquina, junto a cada una de sus cuatro patas.

fr.L: Et tu lui feras quatre anneaux d’or, et tu mettras les anneaux aux quatre coins qui [sont] à ses quatre pieds.
fr.B: Tu lui feras quatre anneaux d’or que tu placeras aux quatre coins, un près de chacun de ses quatre pieds.
fr.R: Fais quatre anneaux d’or et mets-en un à chaque coin, à côté de chacun des quatre pieds.

sw.L: Nawe utaifanyia pete nne za dhahabu, na kuziweka pete hizo kwenye pembe nne zilizo [kwenye] miguu yake minne.
sw.B: Uifanyie pete nne za dhahabu, uziweke kwenye pembe nne, moja karibu na kila mguu wake.
sw.R: Tengeneza pete nne za dhahabu, uweke moja kila pembe, karibu na kila mmoja wa miguu yake minne.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 그것을 위하여 금 고리 넷을 만들어, 그 고리들을 그 네 발에 딸린 네 모퉁이에 달라.
ko.B: 금 고리 네 개를 만들어, 상의 네 다리가 붙은 네 모퉁이에 달라.
ko.R: 금 고리 네 개를 만들어, 네 다리 옆 모퉁이마다 하나씩 달아야 한다.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải làm cho nó bốn khoen vàng, và gắn các khoen vào bốn góc, [là chỗ] thuộc về bốn chân nó.
vi.B: Hãy làm bốn khoen vàng cho bàn và gắn vào bốn góc, mỗi khoen gần một chân bàn.
vi.R: Hãy làm bốn khoen vàng và gắn mỗi khoen vào một góc bàn, bên cạnh mỗi chân bàn.

pt.L: E farás para ela quatro argolas de ouro e porás as argolas nos quatro cantos que [pertencem] aos seus quatro pés.
pt.B: Farás para ela quatro argolas de ouro e as colocarás nos quatro cantos, uma junto a cada um dos seus quatro pés.
pt.R: Faz quatro argolas de ouro e põe uma em cada canto da mesa, junto a cada um dos quatro pés.

decisions.choice: the four corners which belong to its four feet: the corners where the legs are
decisions.reason: The rings are placed at the corners of the table, at the tops of the legs. "Feet" here means the legs of the table.

decisions.choice: legs
decisions.reason: The word is "feet"; for a table Balanced and Readable say "legs". Literal keeps "feet".

decisions.choice: pés
decisions.reason: Portuguese calls the legs of a table "pés", so Balanced and Readable keep the Hebrew word, where the English has to change "feet" to "legs".

source.text: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: Close to the rim will be the rings, for holders for poles to carry the table.

en.L: Close to the frame the rings shall be, as holders for poles, to carry the table.
en.B: Place the rings near the frame; they will hold the poles by which the table is carried.
en.R: Put the rings near the frame. The poles for carrying the table will go through them.

es.L: Junto al marco estarán los anillos, como alojamiento para las barras, para llevar la mesa.
es.B: Pondrás los anillos cerca del marco; en ellos irán las barras con que se lleva la mesa.
es.R: Pon los anillos cerca del marco. Por ellos pasarán las barras para llevar la mesa.

fr.L: Près du cadre seront les anneaux, comme logements pour les barres, pour porter la table.
fr.B: Les anneaux seront près du cadre ; ils recevront les barres qui serviront à porter la table.
fr.R: Mets les anneaux près du cadre. On y passera les barres pour porter la table.

sw.L: Karibu na kiunzi pete zitakuwa, kama vishikio vya mipiko, ili kuibeba meza.
sw.B: Pete ziwekwe karibu na kiunzi; zitashika mipiko ambayo meza itabebwa kwayo.
sw.R: Weka pete karibu na kiunzi. Mipiko ya kubebea meza itapita ndani yake.

ko.L: 턱 가까이에 고리들이 있어, 상을 메는 채들을 꿰는 곳이 되게 하라.
ko.B: 고리들은 턱 가까이에 달아, 상을 메는 채를 꿰는 데 쓰게 하라.
ko.R: 고리들은 턱 가까이에 달아야 한다. 상을 메는 채가 그 고리에 들어갈 것이다.

vi.L: Sát khung các khoen sẽ ở, làm chỗ giữ các đòn để khiêng bàn.
vi.B: Các khoen phải ở gần khung; chúng sẽ giữ các đòn dùng để khiêng bàn.
vi.R: Hãy gắn các khoen gần khung. Các đòn để khiêng bàn sẽ xỏ qua các khoen ấy.

pt.L: Junto à armação estarão as argolas, como suportes para as varas, para levar a mesa.
pt.B: As argolas ficarão perto da armação; nelas passarão as varas com que a mesa será carregada.
pt.R: Põe as argolas perto da armação. As varas para carregar a mesa vão passar por elas.

decisions.choice: holders: housings for the poles
decisions.reason: The word means a place or housing. The rings serve as sleeves to hold the carrying poles.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְנִשָּׂא־בָ֖ם אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make the poles [of] woods of acacia, and you will overlay them [with] gold, and will be carried by them the table.

en.L: And you shall make the poles [of] acacia wood, and overlay them [with] gold, and the table shall be carried by them.
en.B: Make the poles from acacia wood and overlay them with gold. The table will be carried with them.
en.R: Make the poles out of acacia wood, and cover them with gold. Use them to carry the table.

es.L: Y harás las barras [de] madera de acacia, y las revestirás [de] oro, y con ellas se llevará la mesa.
es.B: Harás las barras de madera de acacia y las revestirás de oro. Con ellas se llevará la mesa.
es.R: Haz las barras de madera de acacia y cúbrelas de oro. Úsalas para llevar la mesa.

fr.L: Et tu feras les barres [de] bois d’acacia, et tu les plaqueras [d’]or, et la table sera portée par elles.
fr.B: Tu feras les barres en bois d’acacia et tu les plaqueras d’or. C’est avec elles qu’on portera la table.
fr.R: Fais les barres en bois d’acacia et recouvre-les d’or. Elles serviront à porter la table.

sw.L: Nawe utaifanya mipiko [kwa] mbao za mshita, na kuifunika [kwa] dhahabu, nayo meza itabebwa kwayo.
sw.B: Uifanye mipiko kwa mbao za mshita na uifunike kwa dhahabu. Meza itabebwa kwayo.
sw.R: Tengeneza mipiko kwa mbao za mshita, uifunike kwa dhahabu. Itumie kuibeba meza.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 아카시아 나무로 채들을 만들고 그것들을 금으로 입히라. 그것들로 상을 멜 것이다.
ko.B: 아카시아 나무로 채를 만들어 금으로 입히라. 그 채로 상을 멜 것이다.
ko.R: 아카시아 나무로 채를 만들고 금으로 씌워야 한다. 그 채로 상을 메고 옮긴다.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải làm các đòn [bằng] gỗ keo và bọc chúng [bằng] vàng, và bàn sẽ được khiêng bằng chúng.
vi.B: Hãy làm các đòn bằng gỗ keo và bọc vàng. Bàn sẽ được khiêng bằng các đòn ấy.
vi.R: Hãy làm các đòn bằng gỗ keo và bọc vàng. Hãy dùng các đòn ấy để khiêng bàn.

pt.L: E farás as varas [de] madeira de acácia e as cobrirás [de] ouro, e por elas será levada a mesa.
pt.B: Farás as varas de madeira de acácia e as revestirás de ouro. Com elas a mesa será carregada.
pt.R: Faz as varas de madeira de acácia e cobre-as de ouro. Usa as varas para carregar a mesa.

decisions.choice: the poles ... the table shall be carried: as with the ark
decisions.reason: Like the ark, the table is carried on poles and not handled (verses 13-14; Numbers 4:7-8, 15).

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ קְּעָרֹתָ֜יו וְכַפֹּתָ֗יו וּקְשׂוֹתָיו֙ וּמְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make its dishes and its pans and its jugs and its bowls which will be poured out with them; [of] gold pure you will make them.

en.L: And you shall make its dishes and its pans and its jugs and its bowls with which [drink offerings] are poured out; [of] pure gold you shall make them.
en.B: Make its dishes, its pans, its jars and its bowls, which are used for pouring out drink offerings; make them of pure gold.
en.R: Make its plates, small pans, jars, and bowls out of pure gold. Some of them will be used for pouring out drink offerings.

es.L: Y harás sus platos, y sus cazoletas, y sus jarras, y sus tazones con los cuales se derraman [las libaciones]; [de] oro puro los harás.
es.B: Harás sus platos, sus cazoletas, sus jarras y sus tazones, que sirven para derramar las libaciones; los harás de oro puro.
es.R: Haz de oro puro sus platos, sus cazoletas, sus jarras y sus tazones. Algunos de ellos servirán para derramar las ofrendas de vino.

fr.L: Et tu feras ses plats, et ses coupelles, et ses cruches, et ses coupes avec lesquelles on verse [les libations] ; [d’]or pur tu les feras.
fr.B: Tu feras ses plats, ses coupelles, ses cruches et ses coupes, qui servent à verser les libations ; tu les feras d’or pur.
fr.R: Fais en or pur ses plats, ses petites coupelles, ses cruches et ses coupes. Certaines serviront à verser les offrandes de vin.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya sahani zake, na vijiko vyake, na mitungi yake, na bakuli zake ambazo [sadaka za kinywaji] humiminwa kwazo; [kwa] dhahabu safi utavifanya.
sw.B: Ufanye sahani zake, vijiko vyake, mitungi yake na bakuli zake, vinavyotumiwa kumimina sadaka za kinywaji; uvifanye kwa dhahabu safi.
sw.R: Tengeneza kwa dhahabu safi sahani zake, vijiko vyake, mitungi na bakuli zake. Baadhi yake vitatumika kumimina sadaka za kinywaji.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 그 접시들과 그 작은 그릇들과 그 병들과, 그것으로 [부어 드리는 제물을] 부을 그 대접들을 만들라. 순금으로 그것들을 만들라.
ko.B: 상에 놓을 접시와 작은 그릇과 병과, 부어 드리는 제물을 붓는 데 쓸 대접들을 만들되, 순금으로 만들라.
